_note: Government education-loan relief schemes used by the loan explainer and the financial solver.

loan_schemes.name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS)
loan_schemes.who: Families earning up to Rs 4.5 lakh a year
loan_schemes.benefit: The government pays all interest during the course and one year after (the moratorium), on loans up to Rs 7.5 lakh
loan_schemes.how: Ask the lending bank for CSIS when taking the education loan; there is no separate application

provenance.source_name: Ministry of Education scheme rules (via bank and news summaries)
provenance.evidence: CSIS: 100 % interest subsidy during the moratorium (course + 1 year) for family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh, on loans up to Rs 7.5 lakh; full-time technical/professional courses; applied through the lending bank (Tata Capital and other lender summaries). Confirm current rules with the bank.

loan_schemes.name: PM-Vidyalaxmi
loan_schemes.who: Students admitted to Quality Higher Education Institutions (top-ranked institutions)
loan_schemes.benefit: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans; 75 % government credit guarantee on loans up to Rs 7.5 lakh; 3 % interest subvention during the moratorium on loans up to Rs 10 lakh for family income up to Rs 8 lakh
loan_schemes.how: Apply on the PM-Vidyalaxmi portal; banks process applications there

provenance.source_name: PM-Vidyalaxmi scheme (Cabinet approval Nov 2024; portal launched Feb 2025)
provenance.evidence: Collateral- and guarantor-free loans for QHEI students; 75 % credit guarantee up to Rs 7.5 lakh; 3 % interest subvention on loans up to Rs 10 lakh for family income up to Rs 8 lakh; not combinable with other government scholarships or interest subvention (Business Standard, Business Today, Careers360 reports).
